_comment: Cross-language corpus manifest for the Ask answer-quality eval AND the Rust retrieval-quality baseline (src-tauri/tests/rag_retrieval_quality.rs). Maps each corpus/*.md document to the confidentiality scope (matter) and privilege it is indexed under. corpus.ts asserts its DOC_MATTER map equals this file (drift guard); the Rust test reads this file so both languages index the same corpus the same way. privilege is one of: none | attorney-client | work-product.
